segments.text: One of the most iconic sporting venues in Asia for this quarter final fixture between Al Ahli of Saudi Arabia and Buriram United of Thailand. This is the AFC Champions League Elite Finals Jeddah 2025 presented by NEOM.
No room for error on the road to the final, which will take place on the 3rd of May, and the reward for the winner of this fixture will be that semifinal clash on the 29th of April against Al Hilal.
